text_block_list.text:
One day off. Just as I was about to head 
out—

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: Off we go.
(Click! Vroooom...)

The door of the large limousine parked 
nearby opened... and before I realized it, 
I was guided inside by Saint Light...

text_block_list.name: Hotel Staff
text_block_list.text: —Welcome back, Lady Saint Light.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your hard work.

Where we arrived was an ultra-luxurious 
hotel in the heart of Tokyo. Why here, and 
why me too? I have endless questions, but 
first—

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: This is my base within Tokyo.
choice_data_list: Ah, don't you currently reside in Iwate?

text_block_list.text:
Her parents were distinguished British 
aristocrats, while she herself was born 
and raised in Iwate, so I've heard. And 
that after retiring, she returned straight 
to her hometown.
choice_data_list:
Booking a hotel every time must be quite a 
hassle...

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: I merely return to my own room, after all.
choice_data_list:
(...Wait, does that mean she bought the 
suite?!)

text_block_list.text:
This is a top-tier luxury hotel—just 
staying a single night costs far beyond my 
reach. If she outright owns it...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Driver
text_block_list.text:
My lady. Around what time will you be 
attending the party?

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: I shall send a proxy for that.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer, I leave the matter in 
your capable hands.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
This evening's party is a commemorative 
ceremony celebrating the renovation of a 
horse girl training facility.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
An ancient facility existing since the 
dawn of the Twinkle Series... which had 
been scheduled for demolition.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
However, in an era where methods for 
strengthening horse girls were not yet 
systematized... it served as living proof 
of trial and error undertaken for our 
sake.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
To make us stronger, to make us shine 
brighter... I wished to preserve that 
devotion for future generations.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Thus, humble as it may be... I assisted 
with covering the renovation costs.

...It's a wonderful story showing Saint 
Light's passion for racing. Which makes me 
wonder even more.
choice_data_list: Why send me to that party—
Why send me to that party—

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
My active career lasted but a single 
year... swifter and more dazzling than 
light itself.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
All was for the sake of bringing... the 
pride of the Triple Crown to the racing 
world of Japan.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Single-mindedly, looking neither left nor 
right, running through days spent seeking 
only that... It was intense, and at times 
painful.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Yet that was as it should be. For I was 
born... to love Japanese racing.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: Therefore, I entrust the party to you.
choice_data_list:
...Um, how does what you just said connect 
to that?

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
At present, I am thoroughly relishing my 
leisure time, you see...

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Many racing associates shall be present 
today. It will surely bring thee 
auspicious connections.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
I have already informed our hosts that I 
am sending a proxy. With that, do take 
care.
choice_data_list:
(Looks like there's no way I can turn this 
down...)

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
So-chan. Butter sandwiches, please. With 
plenty of milk, if you will.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Driver
text_block_list.text:
That is why, for now, by that name— ...No, 
setting that aside.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Driver
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me for speaking up, but it seems 
the amount you have been eating lately has 
increased somewhat. Might it be wise to 
hold back on the sweets?

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my. Have I... become even more 
adorably precious again?

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
A plump, delightfully fluffy version of 
myself... how brimming with sheer joy 
could anything be? Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Driver
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Of course, My Lady. Allow me to 
fetch the butter sandwiches right away.
choice_data_list: (Hmm, I really can't figure her out...)

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: Trainer, the party is over that way.
choice_data_list: Ah, yes... I'd love to join in.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. —Observe your surroundings 
carefully and learn well, okay?

Sensing an air of deep benevolence behind 
her smile... I wonder. Perhaps she brought 
me here simply out of thoughtful 
consideration for me—

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Now then. Let us take things veeeery easy. 
...♪
